name: Minimal world
question: Local transitions on a finite state, visible and replayable.
minimal_test: Run the active law and a frozen copy from identical starts. Replay every event.
on_record: Characterised for one law, majority on a ring. Not closed.

name: Scale
question: How effects, costs and limits move with size, resources and time.
minimal_test: Sweep size and capacity separately, then together, against noise and periodic controls.
on_record: One size change tested, 32 to 64 cells. Nothing more.

name: Persistence & response
question: A pattern lasts over a declared time and responds to a declared disturbance.
minimal_test: Flip one cell, compare with a sham and with a plain attractor.
on_record: Response to single pokes is mapped at 32 and 64 cells. Not closed.

name: Boundary
question: A unit keeps its causal identity while its parts are replaced.
minimal_test: Move the proposed boundary and cut interactions of equal cost. See if predictions hold.

name: Resources
question: Limited flows change what can happen and what can be maintained.
minimal_test: Withdraw one flow against a sham, with the same starting stock.
on_record: E0 only keeps a constant count. No flow measured yet.

name: Causal memory
question: A trace of the past changes a later response.
minimal_test: Two histories, same present. Erase or transplant the trace and nothing else.

name: Plasticity
question: Interaction changes a rule or a link, and the change lasts.
minimal_test: Lock the structure or let it move, then test in a reserved context.

name: Organisation
question: Activities help maintain the very conditions that make them possible.
minimal_test: First a measurement that rejects trivial look-alikes. Then cut, replace and compensate inner roles.
on_record: A toy model behaved as written. The first real measurement was rejected. This is where we work.

name: Heredity
question: A variation survives the replacement of the units that carry it.
minimal_test: Remove the transmitted channel, keep the same surroundings.

name: Seeking information
question: An action changes what can be seen, and that changes a later decision.
minimal_test: Offer probes of equal cost and scramble which one is informative.

name: Adaptation
question: The response to a context changes after interaction, with a bounded causal benefit.
minimal_test: Reverse a regularity. Compare trace transfer, erasure and plain selection.

name: Evolution
question: Transmitted variants change in frequency because they spread differently.
minimal_test: Intact against scrambled inheritance, unequal against equalised spread.

name: Communication
question: An emission changes what another system does next. Not words yet: a signal that matters.
minimal_test: Scramble the channel, keep shared inputs, replace the sender with a matched replay.

name: Accumulation
question: A lineage keeps and combines changes beyond what it would rediscover alone.
minimal_test: Chains with an intact or scrambled channel, against an isolated control with equal budget.

name: New individuals
question: A group starts to transmit and depend on itself at its own level.
minimal_test: Scatter and rebuild groups from the same parts.

name: Asking
question: A distinction between possibilities decides which experiment comes next.
minimal_test: Swap what two probes would reveal, then cut the answer. See if choices follow.

name: Causal prediction
question: A retained structure predicts what an unseen intervention will do.
minimal_test: Reserve interventions and recombinations. Ablate the candidate relation.

name: Understanding
question: A relation keeps working after its surface, its place or its context has changed.
minimal_test: Change labels, topology and cause one by one. Compare intact and scrambled carriers.

name: Its own research
question: Otto proposes, intervenes, reads the result and revises, with nobody choosing for it.
minimal_test: A hidden reserved world. Falsify one relation and check that the next test changes.

name: Self-change (optional)
question: A change Otto makes improves its ability to make further useful changes.
minimal_test: Freeze the mechanism after one cycle and compare on a reserved problem.
on_record: An optional branch. No evidence yet.

name: Otto speaks and understands by itself
question: Autonomous, cumulative intelligence: gains in inquiry and transfer, kept and reused across contexts.
minimal_test: Combine separate audits of revision, retention and transfer, each with its own ablations.
on_record: The goal. No current result reaches it.
